name: Rice vinegar
sources: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology, Japan (MEXT). Standard Tables of Food Composition in Japan, eighth revised edition, Supplement 2023. Food number 17016, exact English description: SEASONINGS AND SPICES/Vinegar/rice vinegar. General composition, minerals and vitamins, per 100 g edible portion, accessed 2026-11-23. This is the Japanese rice-vinegar profile, not rice wine or seasoned sushi vinegar, and is not an assertion that all brands are identical. https://fooddb.mext.go.jp/details/details.pl?ITEM_NO=17_17016_7&MODE=0&WEIGHT=100

Nutrient rationale: only explicit numeric entries from MEXT table 01 are included, including explicitly reported zeros. Trace (Tr), missing (-), and parenthesized estimated values are omitted, not replaced by zero. Vitamin A uses retinol activity equivalents; carbohydrates uses the reported total carbohydrate value; calories uses the reported 46 kcal, not a macro-only calculation (organic acids are present). No sugar value is inferred from carbohydrates. Plant-derived vinegar supports vegetarian/vegan attributes; no gluten-free or certification claim is inferred. https://fooddb.mext.go.jp/details/details.pl?ITEM_NO=17_17016_7&MODE=0&WEIGHT=100

National Institute of Standards and Technology. (2026). Handbook 133, Appendix E, General Tables of Units of Measurement. Gram is the mass basis; 1 avoirdupois ounce = 28.349523125 g and 1 avoirdupois pound = 453.59237 g exactly. These are mass units, not fluid ounces. MEXT supplies no spoon/cup gram weights; no density or volume conversion is assumed. https://www.nist.gov/system/files/documents/2025/12/23/2026_NIST_HB133_AppendixE-20251222.docx
